desc:
Eight pack of 16 oz tubs of Pillsbury Creamy Supreme Milk Chocolate Frosting

Ideal for cakes, cupcakes, cookies, brownies and more

Creamy milk chocolate frosting with a decadent and luscious flavor everyone will love

Try customizing with vanilla extract, espresso powder or a pinch of salt

Each tub contains enough frosting to frost about 24 cupcakes

Our Pillsbury frosting is gluten-free

Our pre-made and ready-to-use frosting is ideal for birthdays, holidays, family gatherings and any celebration, big or small

Pillsbury frosting and cake mixes help you and your family create tasty memories together

Once opened, our frosting can be stored in your refrigerator for up to 2 weeks
features:
Key Features:

Rich Milk Chocolate Flavor

Delivers a smooth, creamy taste ideal for decorating cakes, cupcakes, cookies, and brownies.

Ready-to-Use Convenience

No mixing required—just open and spread. Great for quick baking and decorating.

Generous Size

Each 16 oz tub can frost a two-layer cake or up to 24 cupcakes.

Gluten-Free & Shelf-Stable

Safe for gluten-sensitive individuals and doesn’t require refrigeration until opened.

Smooth Texture

Easy to spread with no lumps or graininess, making it perfect for smooth finishes or piping.

Benefits:

Saves Time

Ideal for busy bakers who need a fast, consistent, and delicious frosting option.

Versatile Use

Works as a topping, filling, or dipping option for various desserts.

Kid-Friendly

Familiar chocolate flavor loved by children and adults alike—perfect for parties and lunchbox treats.

Reliable Results

Always the same texture and flavor, making it ideal for home bakers who want consistent outcomes.
ingredients: Sugar, Water, Palm Oil, Corn Syrup, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Corn Starch, Canola Oil, Contains 2% or Less of: Mono- and Diglycerides, Salt, Polysorbate 60, Modified Corn Starch, Natural and Artificial Flavors, Titanium Dioxide (Color), Potassium Sorbate (Preservative), Soy Lecithin, Citric Acid, Xanthan Gum, Antioxidants (Ascorbyl Palmitate and Mixed Tocopherols).
